description: externalScopeSatisfied('validation:write', scopes, alwaysEnforceScope:true) for the Sprint 1.6 vendor WRITE — packages/api/src/access/external-scope.ts. UNLIKE the read surface (empty scope = wildcard), the write ENFORCES the scope unconditionally: an empty-scope key can NOT reach it via the wildcard, so seeding the validation:update grant never silently widens an existing key. Asserted by the REAL TS externalScopeSatisfied (tests/external-vendor/validation-submit-scope-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# Tims.Domain.Access.ExternalScope.ExternalScopeSatisfied (Tims.UnitTests). Bites: flipping alwaysEnforceScope to false makes the empty-scope case go TRUE. requiredScope null models the TS undefined.

cases.name: empty scopes, ENFORCED -> denied (contrast the read's wildcard)
validation:write present among several, enforced -> satisfied
no required scope even when enforced -> satisfied (requiredScope short-circuits first)
